verdict.rationale: Rive documents agent-facing authoring surfaces: RML lets coding agents build Rive files as text, and the CLI lets an agent generate experiences. That implies a programmatic path to the production .riv format, and the open-source runtime programmatically loads and draws .riv files. However, the evidence never explicitly documents an agent-callable export, render or screenshot operation; editor export is described only as an Editor workflow. missing for 10: an explicitly documented programmatic export command or API, screenshot/image rendering for agents, MCP export/render tools, video or image output formats, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface

citations.quote: It lets you create and modify Rive content as code, making it possible to build Rive files with coding agents and other text-based workflows instead of working exclusively in the Editor.
let an agent generate them with the CLI
Loads .riv files, advances state machines and animations, and draws via the abstract Renderer interface.
